A SCHOOL will be opened on the 18th of November, teaching the French, Spanish and Italian languages. The terms will be two dollars entrance and three dollars per month, three lessons a week at such hours as may suit the subscribers.

Subscriptions received at the Book Store of Messrs. JENKS & CLARK.

N. B. Translations in the above languages done with accuracy and dispatch. Post paid.
